en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph depicting the interior of an ancient stone building with arched doorways, thick stone walls, gothic-style windows, massive column, and a prominent medieval fireplace. The architecture features heavy stone construction, vaulted ceilings, and minimal decorative elements, evoking a medieval or early renaissance structure. There is a watermark with the text 'www.elia.org.gr' in the bottom right corner.
